evidence_basis: Illustrative, incomplete project-authored mapping example informed by controlled ISO 26262:2018 Parts 1–12 checks. OSQAr mechanical validation does not establish semantic validity, completeness, applicability, compliance, qualification, certification, or safety. No copyrighted standard text is reproduced and controlled PDFs are not redistributed.

entries.topic: numeric thresholds as OSQAr project policy
entries.project_paraphrase: Any exact percentage, count, or threshold in an OSQAr template is a project-selected acceptance criterion; it is not attributed to ISO 26262.
entries.applicability: Coverage targets, test counts, complexity limits, retention periods, and other numeric acceptance criteria.

entries.topic: exact graph cardinalities as OSQAr project policy
entries.project_paraphrase: Exact required link counts and graph cardinalities are OSQAr validation policy, not a claim about standard-prescribed counts.
entries.applicability: Traceability checks, minimum-link rules, closed inventories, and generated graph acceptance criteria.

entries.topic: coding restrictions as OSQAr project policy
entries.project_paraphrase: Specific language versions, allocation rules, recursion bans, entry/exit constraints, and named coding-rule sets are template policy unless precisely supported by controlled text.
entries.applicability: ASIL-target example implementation constraints and project-selected coding standards.

entries.topic: GPG authenticity mechanism as OSQAr project policy
entries.project_paraphrase: GPG detached signatures are OSQAr's selected mechanism for shipment-manifest authenticity; the mechanism choice is not attributed to ISO 26262.
entries.applicability: OSQAr shipment signing and verification commands.

entries.topic: reproducibility controls as OSQAr project policy
entries.project_paraphrase: OSQAr reproducible-mode defaults and environment controls are project policy and engineering evidence, not a direct standards mandate.
entries.applicability: Shipment builds, tests, timestamps, and source-date environment handling.

entries.topic: fixed SEooC assumption counts as OSQAr project policy
entries.project_paraphrase: The number and starter content of assumptions supplied by an OSQAr template are project scaffolding choices and must be tailored to the actual integration context.
entries.applicability: Template assumptions of use, lifecycle needs, and completeness checks.
